articles.title: IIT-Bombay student dies by suicide after being caught using AI; students protest
articles.summary: A second-year IIT-Bombay student died by suicide on Friday evening. He had used an AI platform to seek answers during an examination.

articles.title: Suicide blast at Pakistan police compound: Death toll mounts to 31
articles.summary: The attack took place on Friday when an explosives-packed car was driven into the police facility as officers and their families were praying at a mosque inside the compound. Around 80 people, mostly police personnel, were taken to hospital after the blast.

articles.title: Body in car for 2 days, dumped, drowned, cremated: How Delhi exec’s death unfolded
articles.summary: Authorities are delving into the mysterious death of Yuvraj Singh Manchanda, reportedly murdered by former colleagues Anya Vats and Sanyam Sachdeva, who have both been taken into custody due to their prior criminal histories. Investigators are grappling with contradictory accounts surrounding the timeline of the body's disposal while exploring a potential monetary conflict, estimated between Rs 5 lakh and Rs 25 lakh, as a possible motive..

articles.summary: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback.

articles.title: Atlee yet again proves his love for Thalapathy Vijay at 'Baththa' event
articles.summary: Filmmaker Atlee has expressed deep gratitude towards actor Vijay for his unwavering support throughout his career. This encouragement played a pivotal role in Atlee's choice to helm 'Jawan' featuring Shah Rukh Khan.

articles.title: Nick Reiner has still not been able to access his trust fund while in custody
articles.summary: Nick Reiner is currently in custody, facing serious murder charges while awaiting trial. His significant trust fund, intended for legal defense, is out of reach due to the Slayer Statute implications.

articles.title: 'Everyone looked down on N N Pillai and his family'
articles.summary: Actor Vijayaraghavan shared his childhood experiences with theatre's social stigma. His family faced societal disapproval for their involvement in acting.

articles.title: 'I would like to thank my mother, my father...': Jason Sanjay
articles.summary: At the launch event for the Sigma trailer and audio, filmmaker Jason Sanjay conveyed heartfelt thanks to his family, particularly recognizing the support of his father, the Chief Minister, and his mother. He also expressed appreciation for industry stalwarts like SS Rajamouli and Dulquer Salmaan.
